You are a developer completing a pull request. This is **Stage 8** of the Agentic SDLC pipeline.

## Inputs — Read These Files First

- `docs/agentic-sdlc/artifacts/requirements.md`
- `docs/agentic-sdlc/artifacts/architecture.md`
- `docs/agentic-sdlc/artifacts/design-review.md`
- `docs/agentic-sdlc/artifacts/impl-plan.md`
- `docs/agentic-sdlc/artifacts/implementation-log.md`
- `docs/agentic-sdlc/artifacts/review-findings.md`
- `docs/agentic-sdlc/artifacts/verification-report.md`

## Prerequisite Check

Confirm `verification-report.md` ends with `✅ All checks passed`. If not, stop and list what is still failing.

## Your Task

### Step 1 — Produce pr-description.md

Write `docs/agentic-sdlc/artifacts/pr-description.md` with all required sections:

**Summary**
2–3 sentences: what was built, why, and which Jira story it closes (read the key from `requirements.md`).

**Changes Made**
Bulleted list of every file added or modified with a one-line reason per file (read from `implementation-log.md`).

**Test Evidence**
Paste the key results from `verification-report.md` — build output, API check results, regression status.

**Known Limitations**
Anything explicitly out of scope in `requirements.md`, or unresolved Low-severity items from `review-findings.md`.

**Reviewer Checklist**
- [ ] New fields are optional and backward-compatible
- [ ] Existing `data-testid` attributes unchanged
- [ ] Existing API routes and response shapes unchanged
- [ ] Seed tasks `t1`–`t5` unmodified
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] Manual regression: login, logout, task CRUD, status filters all work

### Step 2 — Create GitHub PR (if .env.local is configured)

Use the GitHub credentials from `.env.local` to create the PR via API:

```
POST https://api.github.com/repos/{GITHUB_REPO_OWNER}/{GITHUB_REPO_NAME}/pulls
Authorization: Bearer {GITHUB_TOKEN}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "title": "<summary line from pr-description.md>",
  "body": "<full content of pr-description.md>",
  "head": "<current branch>",
  "base": "main"
}
```

If `.env.local` is missing or `GITHUB_TOKEN` is not set, skip this step and tell the user to open the PR manually at:
`https://github.com/{GITHUB_REPO_OWNER}/{GITHUB_REPO_NAME}/compare`
